name: Otone Wataru
source:
The main character. Mihoto, his mother regularly travels overseas for work. Wataru decides not to join his mother and chooses to live with his aunt in a secluded village.

It has been 4 years since he last saw his aunt. She is his first love and he wishes to prove that he has become more manlier to her. Much to his dismay, his aunt still treats him like an innocent child.

During his stay he plans to make his aunt acknowledge him as a man. The village traditions will play a large role in redefining his relationship with his aunt, in good and bad ways.

His family is made up of just his mother and him, he has no father.
